<div class="callout-note" role="note">
<p><strong>The Roadmap was decommissioned in June 2026.</strong></p>
<p>Work to modernise government digital services continues through the <a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/digitising-government-programme-dgp/digital-target-state">Digital Government Target State</a>.</p>
</div>
<h2>Improving government digital services</h2>
<p>The Roadmap aligned effort across government agencies and drove performance as the government moved towards a more unified customer service experience for digital services.</p>
<p>Agencies were responsible for implementing their own initiatives on the Roadmap. The Digital Executive Board oversaw implementation of the Roadmap and led an annual process to refresh it in line with current government priorities. The Digital Executive Board received regular implementation progress reports.</p>
<p>View the Roadmap as a PDF file, or continue browsing this page to view all initiatives.</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/Service-Modernisation-Roadmap-V2-25-Nov-2025.pdf">Service Modernisation Roadmap V2 (<abbr>PDF</abbr> 296<abbr>KB</abbr>)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/insights-and-commentary/delivering-a-unified-customer-service-experience-for-digital-government-services">Read the <abbr>GCDO</abbr>’s commentary on the direction for government digital services</a></li>
</ul>
<h2>Initiatives by layer</h2>
<p>The 4 layers of the Roadmap were:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap/service-modernisation-roadmap-v2#customer-service-experience">Customer service experience</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap/service-modernisation-roadmap-v2#reusable-digital-components">Reusable digital components</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap/service-modernisation-roadmap-v2#data-digital-security-foundations">Data, digital and security foundations</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap/service-modernisation-roadmap-v2#digital-doing-well">Doing digital well</a></li>
</ul>
<p>The full name of each lead agency is provided in the glossary.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap/service-modernisation-roadmap-v2#glossary">Glossary of abbreviations for the Roadmap leads</a></p>
<h2 id="customer-service-experience">Customer service experience</h2>
<p></p>
<div class="table-wrapper" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="table-1" role="region">
<table class="table table-std"><caption id="table-1">
<h3><b>Table 1:</b> Customer service experience — system lead initiatives</h3>
</caption>
<thead>
<tr>
<th scope="col">Initiative</th>
<th scope="col">Lead</th>
<th scope="col">Financial year</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>
<p>Deliver initial release of the Government App, including a roadmap for service onboarding from agencies and a digital wallet</p>
</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Deliver service design and user experience requirements, guidance and tools to guide agencies to deliver improved and more consistent digital customer service experiences</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Deliver an AI virtual assistant to make it easy for people to find and use government information and services confidently</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Provide reporting and insights on high-demand digital services and customer perception to ensure government digital services meet New Zealanders’ needs and expectations</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="table-wrapper" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="table-2" role="region">
<table class="table table-std"><caption id="table-2">
<h3><b>Table 2: </b>Customer service experience — agency lead initiatives</h3>
</caption>
<thead>
<tr>
<th scope="col">Initiative</th>
<th scope="col">Lead</th>
<th scope="col">Financial year</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Enhance digital services for tenancy bond collection and distribution to deliver an improved customer experience</td>
<td>MBIE</td>
<td>FY25/26</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Partner with public libraries to improve digitised government services in communities</td>
<td>DIA (Nat Lib)</td>
<td>FY25/26 to<br>FY26/27</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Develop a new Digital Employment Service to connect jobseekers, employers and training providers, supporting New Zealanders to get into work and reduce the number of jobseekers on benefit</td>
<td><abbr>MSD</abbr></td>
<td>FY25/26</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Deliver a modern digital system to support contracting with partners consistently and transparently, so social sector partners have less red tape and better systems and processes</td>
<td><abbr>MSD</abbr></td>
<td>FY25/26</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Modernise Contact Centre and Workforce Platform to enhance support for court system users</td>
<td><abbr>MoJ</abbr></td>
<td>FY25/26 <br>to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Provide court remote participation services to enhance New Zealanders’ access to justice</td>
<td><abbr>MoJ</abbr></td>
<td>FY25/26 <br>to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2 id="reusable-digital-components">Reusable digital components</h2>
<div class="table-wrapper" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="table-3" role="region">
<table class="table table-std"><caption id="table-3">
<h3><b>Table 3: </b>Reusable digital components — system lead initiatives</h3>
</caption>
<thead>
<tr>
<th scope="col">Initiative</th>
<th scope="col">Lead</th>
<th scope="col">Financial year</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Develop API standards and ensure agencies are able to access key government APIs</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Implement an All-of-Government messaging and notification platform to support the Government App</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="table-wrapper" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="table-4" role="region">
<table class="table table-std"><caption id="table-4">
<h3><b>Table 4:</b> Reusable digital components — agency lead initiatives</h3>
</caption>
<thead>
<tr>
<th scope="col">Initiative</th>
<th scope="col">Lead</th>
<th scope="col">Financial year</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Through FormBuilder, develop similar and more consistent government forms to make it easier for businesses to provide information digitally to government</td>
<td><abbr>MBIE</abbr></td>
<td>FY25/26 <br>to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Migrate surveys to a single consolidated survey platform with multi-modal capability to improve respondent experience and make it easier for businesses to complete surveys</td>
<td>Stats NZ</td>
<td>FY25/26</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Create efficiency and value for money by delivering a payments service design for use across social sector agencies</td>
<td><abbr>MSD</abbr></td>
<td>FY26/27</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Create efficiency and value for money by developing common social sector patterns to speed up eligibility assessment and delivery of social sector products and services to New Zealanders</td>
<td><abbr>MSD</abbr></td>
<td>FY26/27</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Deliver Identity Check service for online identity verification for government services to make it easier for New Zealanders to prove who they are online</td>
<td><abbr>DIA</abbr></td>
<td>FY25/26</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Provide a unified digital photo submission onboarding service (genuine face capture and liveness capabilities) to access government services, that works with Identity Check</td>
<td><abbr>DIA</abbr></td>
<td>FY25/26</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Agencies prepare to use Identity Check and Digital Photo Onboarding for customers who do not have other means of identifying themselves online</td>
<td>Agencies</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Agencies use <abbr>API</abbr> standards, consume and contribute key government <abbr>API</abbr>s</td>
<td>Agencies</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2 id="data-digital-security-foundations">Data, digital &amp; security foundations</h2>
<div class="table-wrapper" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="table-5" role="region">
<table class="table table-std"><caption id="table-5">
<h3><b>Table 5:</b> Data, digital &amp; security foundations — system lead initiatives</h3>
</caption>
<thead>
<tr>
<th scope="col">Initiative</th>
<th scope="col">Lead</th>
<th scope="col">Financial year</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Develop a 2-year roadmap for accelerating use of government AI solutions</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Develop an All-of-Government AI reference architecture to guide the design and implementation of government’s AI solutions, promote best practices and accelerate development across the public service</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Develop a Digital Identity Services Trust Framework reference architecture in conjunction with private/public sectors</td>
<td><abbr>DIA</abbr> (<abbr>DISTFB</abbr>)</td>
<td>FY25/26 <br>to FY26/27</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Implement an All-of-Government issuance platform for digital credentials</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 <br>to FY26/27</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Develop digital standards for web and mobile accessibility to support delivery of user-friendly services for all New Zealanders</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="table-wrapper" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="table-6" role="region">
<table class="table table-std"><caption id="table-6">
<h3><b>Table 6:</b> Data, digital &amp; security foundations — agency lead initiatives</h3>
</caption>
<thead>
<tr>
<th scope="col">Initiative</th>
<th scope="col">Lead</th>
<th scope="col">Financial year</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Provide service interoperability to securely share court information with trusted partners (<span lang="mi">Te Wheke</span>)</td>
<td><abbr>MoJ</abbr></td>
<td>FY25/26 <br>to FY26/27</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Deliver digital case and court management to transform courts’ administration and court users’ experiences (<span lang="mi">Te Au Reka</span>)</td>
<td><abbr>MoJ</abbr></td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Agencies use All-of-Government issuance platform for digital credentials</td>
<td>Agencies</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Agencies prepare to issue and receive digital credentials, including data cleansing as a first step where necessary</td>
<td>Agencies</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Agencies apply All-of-Government AI reference architecture</td>
<td>Agencies</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2 id="digital-doing-well">Doing digital well</h2>
<div class="table-wrapper" tabindex="0" aria-labelledby="table-5" role="region">
<table class="table table-std"><caption id="table-5">
<h3><b>Table 7:</b> Doing digital well — system lead initiatives</h3>
</caption>
<thead>
<tr>
<th scope="col">Initiative</th>
<th scope="col">Lead</th>
<th scope="col">Financial year</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Design an Interim Target State Programme to provide an initial focal point for the ongoing work required towards developing a rolling 5-year digital government target state. The interim Target State will support the delivery of modern, joined up, customer-centric government digital services by consolidating and connecting government’s digital footprint to drive down costs</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Improve the way government invests in and procures digital technology to deliver greater value for money and lower the costs of digital</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 to FY27/28</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Strengthen digital and data capability across the public sector workforce</td>
<td>GCDO</td>
<td>FY25/26 <br>to FY26/27</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2 id="glossary">Glossary of Roadmap leads acronyms</h2>
<dl>
<dt><abbr>DIA</abbr></dt>
<dd>Department of Internal Affairs | <span lang="mi">Te Tari Taiwhenua</span></dd>
<dt><abbr>DISTFB</abbr></dt>
<dd>Digital Identity Services Trust Framework Board — Department of Internal Affairs | <span lang="mi">Te Tari Taiwhenua</span></dd>
<dt><abbr>GCDO</abbr></dt>
<dd>Government Chief Digital Officer — Department of Internal Affairs | <span lang="mi">Te Tari Taiwhenua</span></dd>
<dt><abbr>MBIE</abbr></dt>
<dd>Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment | <span lang="mi">Hīkina Whakatutuki</span></dd>
<dt><abbr>MOJ</abbr></dt>
<dd>Ministry of Justice | <span lang="mi">Te Tāhū o te Ture</span></dd>
<dt><abbr>MSD</abbr></dt>
<dd>Ministry of Social Development | <span lang="mi">Te Manatū Whakahiato Ora</span></dd>
<dt><abbr>Nat Lib</abbr></dt>
<dd>National Library of New Zealand | <span lang="mi">Te Puna Mātauranga o Aotearoa</span></dd>
<dt><abbr>Stats NZ</abbr></dt>
<dd>Statistics New Zealand | <span lang="mi">Tatauranga Aotearoa</span></dd>
</dl>
